ache.title: From underwhelming to terror: buffs sell Pokémon
ache.note: Darkrai went from underwhelming to a ‘battlefield terror’, and this guide shows off the Dark Void and Dark Pulse combo plus a burstier Nasty Plot build. A buff that flips a unit from bad to great is how a game makes you want him right now. The featured codes let you test him, and testing is where wanting starts.

textData.text: In this episode, I delve into Darkrai's transformation from an underwhelming pick to a battlefield terror in Pokémon Unite. I break down the signature Dark Dark Combo of Dark Void and Dark Pulse, highlight alternative builds like Nasty Plot for a burstier playstyle, and discuss key strategies, items, and abilities that make Darkrai formidable. Plus, learn about the powerful Unite Move, Worst Nightmare, and how you can maximize Darkrai's potential. Test out Darkrai with the featured codes and enjoy the havoc it brings.
